description: Add advanced agent skills: email scheduling (schedule campaigns for future send), A/B testing support (multiple prompt variants per campaign), contact scoring/prioritization, email health pre-check, and webhook notifications for campaign events.
steps: Add scheduling support: Add scheduled_at (DateTime, nullable) field to Campaign model. Add /api/campaigns/{id}/schedule endpoint that sets scheduled_at and status to 'Scheduled'. Add a Celery periodic task check (or modify send logic) that picks up scheduled campaigns when their time arrives. Add ScheduledStatus to status badge.

Add A/B testing: Add an ab_variants JSON field to Campaign model (stores list of prompt variants). Add /api/campaigns/{id}/ab-test endpoint that accepts multiple prompt_template variants. During generation, randomly assign contacts to variants. Track which variant each email used (add variant_label field to GeneratedEmail model). Add /api/campaigns/{id}/ab-results endpoint that returns per-variant stats (sent, failed counts).

Add contact scoring: Add a score (Integer, default 0) field to Contact model. Add /api/contacts/{contact_id}/score endpoint (PUT with score value). Add scoring logic that auto-scores contacts based on data completeness (has name +1, has company +1, has role +1, etc.). Sort contacts by score in the preview page (highest first). Add useUpdateContactScore hook.

Add email health pre-check: Add /api/campaigns/{id}/preflight endpoint that validates before sending: checks at least one approved email exists, gmail account is connected, verifies SMTP connectivity, checks rate limits haven't been exceeded. Returns a structured preflight check result. Wire this into the frontend - show a preflight dialog before sending.

Add webhook/notification support: Add WebhookConfig model (id, url, events, active, created_at). Add CRUD endpoints /api/settings/webhooks. On campaign status changes (completed, failed, paused), fire HTTP POST to configured webhook URLs with event payload. Add webhook management UI in settings page.
Update frontend/src/app/campaigns/[id]/preview/page.tsx to show a preflight check dialog when user clicks 'Start Campaign Queue' - run the preflight check first, show results, then allow proceed.
Add scheduling UI to the campaign create/edit pages: a date/time picker for scheduled_at, and show scheduled status in campaign list.
Update frontend/src/app/campaigns/[id]/preview/page.tsx to display contact scores and allow reordering by score.
Add A/B test configuration UI in campaign create page: allow adding multiple prompt variants with labels, show which variant was used in the preview table.
Add webhook configuration section to the settings page with URL input, event selector (checkboxes for completed/failed/paused), test webhook button.
Update the sidebar to reflect any new navigation items if needed.
acceptance_criteria: Campaigns can be scheduled for future sending with a datetime picker
A/B testing allows multiple prompt variants and tracks results per variant
Contacts get auto-scored based on data completeness and can be manually scored
Preflight check runs before sending and shows a pass/fail dialog
Webhook configuration CRUD works and webhooks fire on campaign status changes
All new backend endpoints have proper error handling and input validation
Backend tests pass for new endpoints
verification: cd /projects/sandbox/automatic-mail-sender-agent/frontend && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run build
